limits.en: 3,000 emails/month, capped at 100 emails/day, 3 domains, 30-day data retention

keyLimits.en: 50,000 emails/month included, pay-as-you-go overage at $0.90 per 1,000 emails
100,000 emails/month included, scales up to 2,500,000 emails/month at $1,150, dedicated IP add-on available

addOns.en: Dedicated IP: $30/month, for Scale plan customers sending 3,000+ emails/day
Extra domains: $20/month for 100 additional domains on Pro and Scale

cautions.en: Self-serve plans are billed monthly only; there is no annual discount.
A separate Marketing plan track (contacts-based, Free up to 1,000 contacts, Pro from $40) exists alongside the transactional plans; the two are billed independently.

capabilities.en: Developer email API for transactional and batch email sending (up to 100 emails per request), with official SDKs for Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Rust, .NET and Laravel.
React Email integration for building email templates as React components.
Domain verification and deliverability tooling (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), webhooks for delivery events, and inbound email processing.
Marketing email features: contact/segment management and automation flows, billed separately by contact count.

limitations.en: Free plan capped at 100 emails per day even though the monthly quota is 3,000, which limits burst sending.
No annual billing discount on self-serve plans; enterprise-only custom terms exist above Scale.
Explicitly prohibits inbox scraping and unsolicited bulk email; recipients must have opted in.

reason.en: Another developer-first transactional email API with usage-based pricing.
Combines transactional and marketing email in one platform with a generous free tier.
Alternative for teams that want marketing email plus basic transactional sending.
